wa_numbah_ten.notes: SCOPE / RELATIONS: this row is the free first pitch of the original multi-pitch aid line Numbah Ten (MP credits an 'FFA P1'; thetopo lists 'Numbah Ten (original)' A3, 'Numbah Ten p1 (free)' and 'Numbah Ten P2' A2 X). The guide lists Numbah Ten as one pitch, 5.12b, Sport, 4 stars, so this row stays the route. Numbah Ten P3 (wa_numbah_ten_p3) is the original line's third pitch: a separate 80 ft trad pitch that starts on the ledge atop Model Worker P1 (MP; reach it via Princely Ambitions and a 15 m traverse). P2 (A2 X, nails under a huge loose block, thetopo) has no row and should not get one without a free description. Comfortably Numbah 10 (wa_comfortably_numbah_10) is a variation START, not a separate line: it leaves the ground on the Iron Horse flake and follows bolts left to join Numbah Ten at its 5th bolt, then finishes on Numbah Ten's bolts and anchor (MP). Amandla (wa_amandla) also starts up Numbah Ten. CATALOG: variations[0] spells it 'Amandala' (MP and the guide: Amandla) and gives 5.13c (guide 5.13c, MP 5.13+); report only. SAFETY: rebolted Oct 2015 with new bolts and anchors (MP comment); MP still says to stick-clip the second bolt. No stored prose describes gone gear. Not on or below Great Northern Slab; no post-2023 rockfall change reported (Comfortably Numbah 10, which shares its upper bolts, has comments from Jul-Sep 2026).

wa_numbah_ten_p3.notes: SCOPE / CATALOG DEFECT (report only): this row is pitch 3 of the original Numbah Ten aid line (parent wa_numbah_ten holds only the free P1). MP: it begins atop the first full pitch of Model Worker, most easily reached by climbing Princely Ambitions and traversing about 15 m right on the ledge; it climbs right through a white alcove/arch and two stepped flakes past one pin to a belay shared with the top of Tadpole (or a short scramble to the Beak! Beak! Beak! / Newest Industry belay). Halfway up you can step right past one bolt onto the top half of Iron Horse P2 (wa_iron_horse_p2). The guide does not list it. Only access and null-only gear are proposed; nothing locked. Owner decides whether it stays as its own row. FA unknown on MP (stored null, correct). Not near Great Northern Slab; no rockfall report.

wa_comfortably_numbah_10.notes: SCOPE / CATALOG DEFECT (report only): a variation START to Numbah Ten (wa_numbah_ten), not a separate line. MP: leave the ground on the Iron Horse flake, follow bolts left and join Numbah Ten at its 5th bolt at the entrance of the flare, then continue on Numbah Ten's bolts to its anchor; it skips Numbah Ten's bouldery start. A Jul 2026 comment says it is also a more direct way to start Amandla. MP-only (not in the Index guide's list), so under the batch S rule it is a clean-up candidate; owner decides. Only access proposed. pitches 1 left (it ends at Numbah Ten's anchor, so it is a full lead). SAFETY: a Sep 2026 comment reports a plated quicklink (likely a bail link) removed from the upper crux bolt. Comments run to Sep 2026; no rockfall change.

wa_tommy_s_sandbox.notes: SCOPE: its own route, not a pitch of City Park. It is the pitch above the Slow Children anchor; the guide and MP both list it on its own (MP's City Park page names it as 'another option above Slow Children', separate from City Park's P3-P4). Usual link: Godzilla (or City Park P1) / City Park P2 (wa_city_park_p2) / Slow Children / Tommy's Sandbox. Kept as a route, full research. SAFETY (descent, not in stored prose): MP says rappelling from Tommy's own anchor is a rope stretcher and several parties have come up short with a 70 m rope to the Slow Children anchor; traverse about 20 ft right to the Park Ranger anchor and rap from there (still almost 35 m). The pitch has runouts on gear and heavy rope drag unless bolts and gear are extended (2024 comments); moss and wet slab after dry spells (2015). Climbed in 2024 and Oct 2026: no rockfall change, not on or below Great Northern Slab.
